task: N1.4d component boundary freeze and metadata-only qualification
frozen_target: bounded components, not a complete automatic detector
current_stage_forbidden_inputs: new candidate diffs or source bodies
assessment or raw model answer text

selection.overlap_policy: problem-title queue first, omit its choices from change-title queue

exposure_policy: Separate initial screening from method-development reading and fix-family contact. No hit in bounded indexes is only not_found_in_checked_records, never proof of global non-exposure. Already-read/family/unknown remain separate.
qualification_policy: Metadata can nominate candidates but cannot establish same-mechanism positive or same-use normal. Qualified denominators stay zero until separate source review under the next protocol.
comparison_policy: Same parent-source/configuration/reference and reviewed summary inputs for direct-model and component-assisted variants; separately disclose model-inferred versus researcher-supplied predicates, roles and summaries.
ablation_policy: Forced insufficient after removing a required premise is a gate/dependency control, not accuracy improvement. Count unsupported claims, insufficiency and manual intervention separately.
